name: Goldkine | Permanent Marker
description: Introducing Permanent Marker, an indica-dominant strain from Biscotti, Jealousy, and Sherbet BX strains. Perfect for lazy afternoons, this strain offers a creative euphoria followed by calming relaxation without heavy sedation and ends with a wave of hunger. It’s ideal for treating chronic fatigue, PMS, cramps, depression, mood swings, stress, and PTSD. Enjoy its sweet and sour fruity candy flavor with a citrusy diesel punch, and its aroma of spicy diesel and sour citrus. Permanent Marker features dense emerald-green nugs with purple leaves, orange hairs, and amber-tinted white trichomes. Enjoy a blissful, relaxing experience with Permanent Marker.
